about: An id longer than SourceBounds.idLength, 64 characters (chapter 1 § 1.6). Invalid: the manifest declares an input whose id is 65 characters. Valid: 64, the limit.
sentences: Id 'referral_letter_from_the_family_doctor_with_the_recent_blood_resu' is 65 characters; the most is SourceBounds.idLength (64).
